settings.title:
Worn,
not preached.
settings.text: Two founders. One line we couldn't stop thinking about.

settings.heading:
When we fall,
we rise.
settings.text:
EDEN didn't start in a studio. It started with two of us, a lot of bad days and one line that kept us standing: faith over fear. Not as a slogan for other people. As a reminder for ourselves.

We wanted clothes that said it without shouting. No church clichés, no stock imagery. Just the words, the nails and the weight of a hoodie that feels like armour.

settings.title:
Two nails.
One D.
settings.text:
The nails are the moment everything broke, and the reason nothing has to stay broken. We put them over the D because that's where the story turns.

Every Chapter we release carries that idea somewhere: in the print, in the label, in the weight of the fabric.

settings.title: Worn, not preached
settings.text: Faith you can live in. We'd rather you feel it than read it.

settings.title: Made to order
settings.text: Every piece is produced after you order it. No overstock, no landfill, no shortcuts.

settings.text: 440 g/m² combed cotton, pre-shrunk and washed. Oversized, drop shoulders, made to outlast the moment.
